plugins.name: daikenja
plugins.description: Not an assistant -- a sage you consult. It reads the threads, documents, meetings and code you are buried in and hands back something you can act on: a verdict on a draft, a review of how you handled a thread, a plain markdown ledger of what a project decided and what is still open. It never sends and never publishes. Claude Code only.
